title: RingedSectionLocalization
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings. Use its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For a global section $s$ define $\mathcal O[1/s]$ to be the module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the actual presheaf $V\mapsto\mathcal O(V)[1/s|_V]$, with restriction maps given by localization lifts. Its canonical map from $\mathcal O$ is the sheafified algebra map. For $f\in\mathcal O(U)$, restrict $f$ to a global section on the slice [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] and apply this same construction on the slice to define $\mathcal O_U[1/f]$.
